    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CausalAudit
    Receives Parsley's per-record causal-buffering events: forwarded, held, released, evicted (causal violation), eviction-limit-exceeded (fail-fast instead of a violation), undecodable, and unresolvable-clock (an undecodable dependencies header at ingest).
    CausalBuffer<K,V>
    Registers one causal source: a topic name paired with the serdes Parsley's buffer uses to (de)serialise records held from that topic.
    CausalBufferLimit
    Defines when records held in a causal buffer should be evicted.
    CausalDependencies
    A producer-stamped set of causal requirements: the positions a consumer must have observed before a record stamped with these dependencies may be delivered.
    CausalDependencies.Builder
    Builder for CausalDependencies.
    CausalProcessors
    Factory for CausalProcessorSupplier — the decorating causal processor you drop into a Kafka Streams topology with stream(...).process(...).
    CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut>
    Builder for a CausalProcessorSupplier.
    CausalProcessorSupplier<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut>
    A ProcessorSupplier that wraps an ordinary user ProcessorSupplier so it runs behind Parsley's causal guarantee.
    CausalTopics
    Resolves a topic name to its stable Kafka UUID — the identity CausalDependencies key their coordinates by, so that a topic deleted and recreated under the same name is treated as a different topic.
